newsitem.title: GERMANY: Technical problems create chaos on German bourse.
newsitem.headline: Technical problems create chaos on German bourse.

text.p: All floor trading in equities, bonds and derivatives was temporarily suspended on German markets Wednesday because of massive system problems.
"All trading in Frankfurt and the nation's regional bourses has been temporarily suspended due to system problems," a spokesman for the Frankfurt Stock Exchange said.
Trading resumed after about an hour and was allowed to continue for an extra hour to make up for the suspension.
Sources at the Frankfurt exchange said the hitch stemmed from a system overload.
It was the second time this week that bourse trading was interrupted due to technical problems.
German stocks and bonds were racing higher as business was halted with the DAX index of 30 leading shares up 164.57 at 493.44 and IBIS DAX index of electronic trade up 105.06 points at 4,402.70.
Earlier, the DAX index had hit an all-time high at 4,418.64 points.
Traders said Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's upbeat testimony to Congress Tuesday was behind the gains.
